The environmental sensors measure temperature, humidity, and CO2 concentration."},{"source_unit_id":"P2","text":"Externally, there are the meteorological agency forecast service and the power company; the cultivation manager handles equipment operation, and the equipment technician handles equipment repair."},{"source_unit_id":"P3","text":"At 10:00 p.m., the GMS receives a forecast of an early-morning minimum temperature of -12 °C from the meteorological agency forecast service. If the forecast temperature is -10 °C or less, the GMS issues the cold-wave alert mode. The GMS issues the cold-wave alert mode and sends a notification to the cultivation manager."},{"source_unit_id":"P4","text":"In the cold-wave alert mode, the thermal curtain unit closes the thermal curtain, and Boiler 1 maintains the greenhouse target temperature at 15 °C. The two measures start simultaneously."},{"source_unit_id":"P5","text":"The environmental sensors measure the indoor temperature every 10 min and transmit it to the GMS. If the indoor temperature drops below 12 °C, the GMS additionally operates Boiler 2."},{"source_unit_id":"P6","text":"At 2:00 a.m., when the environmental sensors measure an indoor temperature of 11.5 °C, the GMS operates Boiler 2."},{"source_unit_id":"P7","text":"At 3:00 a.m., Boiler 1 stops due to a combustion failure. The GMS detects the Boiler 1 stop and requests an emergency dispatch from the equipment technician."},{"source_unit_id":"P8","text":"After arriving, the equipment technician inspects the ignition device and replaces the clogged fuel filter. When the filter replacement is finished, the equipment technician reignites Boiler 1."},{"source_unit_id":"P9","text":"Until Boiler 1 is reignited, the cultivation manager stops the nutrient solution supply. This is because a low nutrient solution temperature causes root damage."},{"source_unit_id":"P10","text":"At 4:20 a.m., when Boiler 1 is reignited and the indoor temperature recovers to 15 °C, the cultivation manager resumes the nutrient solution supply."},{"source_unit_id":"P11","text":"At 7:00 a.m., when the outdoor temperature rises to -5 °C or more, the GMS releases the cold-wave alert mode and stops Boiler 2."},{"source_unit_id":"P12","text":"If the indoor humidity is 90% or more, the cultivation manager opens the vent window for 5 min. On this day, the humidity stayed at 85%, so the vent window was not opened."},{"source_unit_id":"P13","text":"The goal of this scenario is to maintain the indoor temperature at 12 °C or more without
